lane: غُرْمُولٌ The _penis,_ (S, O, K,) in an absolute sense: (TA:) or _a large and flaccid penis before its prepuce is cut off;_ (K;) thus says AZ: (TA:) or it is said to be _of a solid-hoofed animal:_ but mention is made in a trad. of the غَرَامِيل of men [in relation to whom, however, it may perhaps be used in this instance by way of comparison]. (TA.)

entries.text: الغرمول، بالضم: الذكر، أو الضخم الرخو قبل أن تقطع غرلته. وكقنفذ: اسم والد يعقوب المحدث. والغراميل: هضاب حمر.
